description.value: A Mosaic Forest Management lakeside campsite on northern Vancouver Island, reached via active forestry roads; rustic and quiet with a lake as the main draw.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wokas Lake as an active, reservation-required campsite with 2026 reservable dates (April 2–October 13), operated on Mosaic Forest Management land by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd. The FAQ explicitly states all Mosaic campgrounds are 'rustic,' meaning 'pit toilets, no potable water, no power or hookups, and no garbage service,' which provides direct positive evidence for pit toilets and explicit negative evidence for potable water, flush toilets, device charging, and e-bike charging. The website contact page lists phone 250.714.9525 and email info@mosaiccampsites.com, both differing from the OSM tags (+1 250-830-7300; wpcampsite@hotmail.com), indicating the OSM contact info is outdated.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1 250-830-7300 but website contact page shows 250.714.9525; website value used.
Email mismatch: OSM lists wpcampsite@hotmail.com but website contact page shows info@mosaiccampsites.com; OSM email likely outdated.
OSM operator listed as 'Timberwest' but website indicates day-to-day management by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd. under Mosaic Forest Management.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating campsite confirmed open for 2026 on a managed operator's website, useful to touring cyclists as a wilderness lakeside campsite near Campbell River.
enrichment_extras.notes: Active resource roads with logging truck traffic are a safety consideration for cyclists; campsite rules state logging trucks have right of way.

wow_evidence: reached via active forestry roads; rustic and quiet
